description: A real government fiscal organization (徴収/会計所管) as a KEYLESS observational mirror-actor (entity-as-actor, ADR-2606042330), emitted by the danjo revenue-ledger. etzhayyim holds NO key and does NOT represent or act for the org: `keyless` MUST be true and `verificationMethod` MUST be empty (no-server-key, ADR-2605231525). The record links the org to the taxes it collects / accounts it administers — observational only, never a claim of agency or endorsement. Aggregate local-government mirrors declare `aggregate`+`representsCount` (coverage honesty: 47都道府県 / 1741市町村 collapsed into one mirror is explicit, not hidden).

displayName.description: 日本語名称 (e.g. 国税庁)

keyless.description: MUST be true. The mirror holds no key (no-server-key).

verificationMethod.description: MUST be empty — a mirror cannot sign. no-server-key (ADR-2605231525).

aggregate.description: true if this mirror collapses many real units (coverage honesty).

representsCount.description: number of real units collapsed (e.g. 47 / 1741) when aggregate.

collectsTaxes.description: taxId list this org collects (→ taxClassification)

administersAccounts.description: account ids this org administers (e.g. special/reconstruction)
